references.text: Moses went out to his brothers and saw their forced labor. This verse uses the same expression 'went out' (וַיֵּצֵא) and also concerns a conflict between Israelites and Egyptians.
A mixed crowd also went up with the Israelites from Egypt. This explains how there could be children of mixed marriages between Israelites and Egyptians.
The mixed multitude that was among them fell to craving. This refers to the same group of people of mixed origin who followed the Israelites.
A man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath day, and he was brought before Moses. A similar situation where a lawbreaker is brought forward for judgment in the camp.
Concerns wicked men who have led the inhabitants of their city astray. The theme of strife and conflict within Israel's camp and community.
